description: Implementation of Vulkan descriptor set management classes including DescriptorSet, DescriptorSetPile, and DescriptorPool for resource binding and descriptor pool handling in Vulkan API.

classes.name: DescriptorSet
classes.description: Manages Vulkan descriptor set including resource binding and handle retrieval.

classes.name: DescriptorSetPile
classes.description: Handles a batch of descriptor sets for efficient allocation.

classes.name: DescriptorPool
classes.description: Manages Vulkan descriptor pool and associated descriptor set piles.

methods.name: DescriptorSet::bind
methods.description: Binds a VulkanBuffer or VulkanImage to the descriptor set at a specified index.

methods.name: DescriptorSet::get_bind_handle
methods.description: Updates and retrieves the Vulkan descriptor set handle.

methods.name: DescriptorSet::add_binding
methods.description: Adds or updates a resource binding within the descriptor set.

methods.name: DescriptorSetPile::get_descriptor_set
methods.description: Retrieves a descriptor set handle from the pile, allocating new ones if necessary.

methods.name: DescriptorSetPile::allocate_new_batch
methods.description: Allocates a new batch of descriptor sets from the Vulkan descriptor pool.

methods.name: DescriptorPool::get_descriptor_set
methods.description: Provides a descriptor set, creating a new pile if needed.

methods.name: DescriptorPool::init
methods.description: Initializes the descriptor pool with specified configuration.

methods.name: DescriptorPool::flush
methods.description: Resets the descriptor pool and clears all descriptor set piles.
